notes: Italy + Spain + Singapore. TIM 12+1 month rule from official support page. Movistar 6-month rule from official community KB. Singtel critical finding: passport-registered prepaid SIMs limited to 30-day validity unless re-registered IN PERSON at Singtel shops (IMDA regulation from 2024-07-15) — effectively kills SG as a foreigner keep-alive market.

routes.acquisitionSummary: Official (tim.it support, 2026-09-26): TIM Card lasts 12 months from activation / last recharge / any commercial event. Deactivation at 13 months (12 + 1 month receive-only). Reactivation possible after expiry.

keep.action: Any recharge (min €5) resets the 12-month clock (official). 13th month = receive-only, then deactivation; reactivation window exists post-expiry.

routes.chinaActivation: Italian prepaid requires ID (passport) registration; typically in-store Italy. Online eSIM + passport flow 验证中.
routes.roamingSms: Receiving abroad works (EU roaming zone free; China receive 验证中).
routes.tariffSummary: 12-month validity per recharge; €5/yr keep; 13th month receive-only.

routes.acquisitionSummary: Official community KB: prepaid validity 6 months from activation, renewed with each recharge. Lifecycle: sufficient balance → full service; balance exhausted → receive-only phase.

keep.action: Recharge (min ~€5) every 6 months renews validity (official KB).

routes.chinaActivation: Spanish prepaid passport registration; in-store standard; abroad activation unverified.
routes.roamingSms: EU roaming standard; China receive 验证中.

routes.acquisitionSummary: Official FAQ PDF (2024-11-04): per IMDA regulation from 2024-07-15, SIMs registered with a PASSPORT get only 30 days validity; retaining beyond 30 days requires IN-PERSON re-registration at Singtel Shop / Exclusive Retailer / mRemit Lucky Plaza.

keep.action: BLOCKED for overseas users: 30-day passport validity + in-person re-registration requirement makes remote keep-alive impractical.

routes.chinaActivation: eSIM available but 30-day passport cap applies regardless.
routes.kyc: IMDA-mandated registration; passport = 30-day cap; Singpass (SG resident) = full validity.
routes.roamingSms: hi!Roam packs exist; moot given 30-day cap.
